tools.name: compare_brands
tools.description: Returns two brands of the same published brand board side by side: each brand's AI model choice share with its confidence interval and tier, the board's headline claims and conditions, and the ids of published battles between the two brands, if any. tools.name: list_battles
tools.description: Lists the published, production-signed Pickbench battles (two options measured head to head by a panel of API models): pair id, category code, the two products and their brands. A battle compares two products, not the brands overall. Optionally one category. Read-only.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Returns a short summary of how Pickbench measures which brands AI models choose, the methodology page URL, how to verify a signed snapshot, and how to cite a result (name the API models, the panel and the conditions; give the interval). Read-only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "v3" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_pick_share, compare_brands, battle_result, get_methodology · Public sink: ai_pick_share, compare_brands, battle_result, pick_drift.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ai_pick_share, compare_brands, battle_result, get_methodology · Public sink: ai_pick_share, compare_brands, battle_result, pick_drift

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
